string.text: How long travel notifications stay on screen (seconds).
Off = watch each teleport/step live (debug). On = black fade between path steps.
Draw the planned route on the PDA map when you open a travel destination.
Blocks level transitions while an alerted enemy is engaging you within ambush range.
Show Ambush Range on PDA Map
Yellow ring = LoS ambush range (default 100m; weather, daylight, and sneaking shrink it). Enemies that go agro also interrupt travel.

True Fast Travel: path steps with in-mod time simulation. Places its own base/campfire map icons (no Fair Fast Travel needed for that). Unlock travel by walking near them (bases 50m, campfires/zone exits 30m) — unvisited ones say "Not visited yet". Guides ignore that. Journeys cannot be cancelled once started. Disable Fair Fast Travel and Limited Fast Travel.
